Three small follow-ups, in order, each on its existing branch. Use a worktree per branch, merge the latest origin/main first, push with an explicit refspec, check ls-remote.
(1) PR #603 (branch wp-cleanup-cli-tooling, Entire change callisto/211): finding 01M7XMCZD173 (medium) is valid. After the three build handlers were merged into one, build_from_intent (crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/release.rs around lines 373-374) canonicalizes the artifact directory before the dry-run guard, so 'release build-python --dry-run --intent intent.json --artifact-dir missing-dir' returns E213 exit 1 instead of E309 exit 2; pack_npm has the same ordering (around line 423). Move artifact-directory resolution after the shared dry-run check, with a binary-level test first for build-python and pack-npm, then resolve the finding after the push.
(2) PR #604 (branch worktree-wp-cleanup-graph): resolve its conflicts with main in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs (K, #596, merged) and crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/provider/registry.rs. Keep main's behaviour and the cleanup's deletions. Run cargo test -p callisto-graph and just lint.
(3) PR #602 (branch wp-changesets-differential): #596 has merged, so in scenario (a) stop appending the [[fixed-group]] by hand. Assert that the callisto.toml written by 'callisto init' contains the fixed group, then keep the same release-plan comparison against the real Changesets. Update the PR body note. Run that test with --ignored as before.
Report in 4 lines to the lead session (close-gap-for-alpha). Rules (from the lead session close-gap-for-alpha). Be fast and lean; GitHub CI runs the full suite, so don't duplicate it.
- Read AGENTS.md. Prefer a type or private constructor over a check; delete checks a type makes redundant; fix sibling call sites in the same PR.
- No new traits, async or frameworks. No new error codes, JSON keys or flags without asking the lead.
- Work in a named worktree off fresh origin/main. Write the failing test first for behaviour changes.
- Local checks: `cargo test -p <touched crate>` and `just lint` (clippy) for the crates you touched; `just doc-check` if docs changed. Do not run local `just ci` or a fresh reviewer unless the lead asks; let GitHub CI do the full run.
- If you change a public signature in callisto-manifests or callisto-model, also run `just fuzz-check` (the fuzz crate is outside the workspace, so crate tests miss it).
- Run `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff` only for new decision logic, not for merges, renames, docs, CI or tests; never commit mutants.out*.
- Merges and conflict resolutions: resolve, run the touched crate's tests, push. Nothing else.
- Changeset (`cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add ...`) only for user-visible changes, written for users.
- Signed commits, no session trailer. Merge the latest origin/main right before pushing (no rebase, no force-push). Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, confirm with git ls-remote, link the given trail, open with entire trail ci-pr.
- If CI fails, fix that failure only. If Entire raises findings, fix only wrong results, broken recovery, security issues or checks that cannot fail; report the rest to the lead.
- Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines: PR, sha, what you ran.
- CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is cores/5; never run two cargo builds in one worktree.

# The local npm, PyPI and Cargo registries the real-registry suites run against, and the Changesets 2.x and 3.x CLIs
# the compatibility differential runs against, installed under target/verify-real.
# gunicorn: pypiserver's default backend does a slow getfqdn() bind. setuptools and wheel: the offline Python build.
verify-real-tools:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    for tool in npm uv; do
        command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "$tool is required: the install matrix uses npm, pnpm and uv" >&2; exit 1; }
    done
    tools=target/verify-real
    mkdir -p "$tools"
    npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --prefix "$tools/npm" verdaccio@6.10.4 pnpm@11.9.0 @changesets/cli@3.0.3
    npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --prefix "$tools/changesets-2" @changesets/cli@2.31.1
    PATH="$PWD/$tools/npm/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" pnpm --version
    PATH="$PWD/$tools/npm/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" changeset --version
    "$tools/changesets-2/node_modules/.bin/changeset" --version
    uv venv -q --seed --allow-existing --python 3.12 "$tools/venv"
    python_pins="pypiserver==2.4.0 twine==6.2.0 build==1.4.4 legacy-cgi==2.6.3 gunicorn==26.2.0 setuptools==80.9.0 wheel==0.45.1"

    cargo install --locked --root "$tools/cargo" cargo-http-registry@0.1.8

Usage:
  entire trail link <trail> [flags]

Flags:
      --base string              Base branch the change merges into; with --branch-action create, the new branch also starts from it
      --branch string            Branch to use (defaults to the current feature branch; create derives one from the title on the base branch)
      --branch-action string     Branch action: link existing remote work, or create a new branch (default "link")
  -h, --help[=true|false]        help for link
      --idempotency-key string   Retry key for linking a branch; with intent-only creation, requires project management
      --json[=true|false]        Output raw JSON instead of a table
      --status string            Lifecycle status (open, closed)

Create or link the GitHub pull request that backs a trail, so the repository's CI runs on its branch. Only GitHub-backed trails with changes on an open branch have one.

<trail> is a project trail number, ID, or <repo>/<number>. Without one, follow the current branch's
parent. --repo and --branch select a working context; only that branch is affected.

      --context name     Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)
